reporting_impact: A missing crash ID prevents reliable record tracing.
recommended_action: Stop publication and investigate the source record.

reporting_impact: Duplicate IDs can double-count crashes and casualties.
recommended_action: Resolve duplicate keys before using aggregates.

reporting_impact: Negative casualty counts invalidate outcome metrics.
recommended_action: Correct or exclude invalid source records.

check_name: Fatal severity agrees with fatal count
reporting_impact: Severity and casualty measures could tell conflicting stories.
recommended_action: Review the source classification and casualty counts.

check_name: Non-injury crashes have no fatal or serious counts
reporting_impact: Serious outcomes could be hidden in a non-injury category.
recommended_action: Review source definitions before reporting severity.

check_name: Crash year aligns with financial year
reporting_impact: Invalid periods can distort annual and financial-year trends.
recommended_action: Correct invalid periods before time-based reporting.

reporting_impact: Incomplete TLA fields can misstate detailed geographic results.
recommended_action: Retain national totals and caveat or exclude affected local records.

reporting_impact: Missing area-unit or meshblock values limit detailed mapping.
recommended_action: Use national reporting normally and caveat fine-grained geography.

check_name: Crash severity uses an expected category
reporting_impact: Unexpected categories can fragment or omit severity totals.
recommended_action: Map new values explicitly before reporting.

reporting_impact: Missing regions reduce completeness of subnational reporting.
recommended_action: Monitor the rate by year and caveat regional outputs.

check_name: Non-injury crashes have no minor injury count
reporting_impact: Minor injury counts attached to non-injury crashes need definition review.
recommended_action: Keep as a monitored exception and avoid silent reclassification.

reporting_impact: Missing injury counts can understate casualties.
recommended_action: Review the record and document any retained exception.
